topic: NGINX integration shows no data after moving to Autodiscovery labels
symptom_pattern: After migrating integration config from conf.d files to Docker labels, the NGINX integration tile shows no data; logs from the container still arrive.
root_cause: The Autodiscovery check label has a typo in the check name (e.g. 'ngnix') or points nginx_status_url at localhost, so either nothing is scheduled or the check can't connect.
resolution_path: Run agent configcheck to see whether an nginx check was resolved for the container
Fix the check name / use %%host%% and verify agent status

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you share the labels on the nginx container?

qa_pairs.customer_answer: There's an error about a check named ngnix not being found, but I assumed that was a warning.

customer_style.tone: friendly, admits they might have made a mistake
